management_explainer_intro: Track planned budget, spend, and F4/F5 reporting. This page includes portal projects and older imported activities.
management_explainer_metrics_scope: The top Plan, Actuals, Variance, and Individuals/Families cards are for all data. Filters change the table and the second row of cards (projects, MOUs, F4/F5, tracker).
management_explainer_metrics_bullets: % F4 — actuals ÷ plan (how much of the budget was spent)
% F5 — how many projects have an F5
Tgt Ind / Tgt Fam — people planned in F1
Act Ind / Act Fam — people reached in F5
With MOUs / With F4s / With F5s — counts in your current filter
Summary by Grant — same numbers, one row per grant
management_explainer_metrics_tracker_bul: Each project: F4 score + F5 score (max 100%). Grouped rows show the average.
Completed — 50% each (F4 completed uses 50% × spend ÷ plan)
management_explainer_metrics_overdue_bul: Due 32 days after the transfer date. After that, overdue until both F4 and F5 are Partial, In review, or Completed.
Grouped rows show a count. A project row shows days overdue.
management_explainer_ui_bullets: Click a state, then an ERR, then a project. Back goes up a level.
Filter by grant, dates, F4/F5 status, historical vs new (from 2026), and more.
Open a project for details. Upload F4/F5 or change status if your role allows. Export the rows on screen.
